config.title: Agent Dock
config.servers.description: Remote servers. Each entry: `{ name, host, user?, port? }`. `host` may be an alias from ~/.ssh/config.
config.sessionLimit.description: Max sessions scanned per agent per server (most recently updated first).
config.connectInNewWindow.description: Open the remote server in a new window when connecting (default: reuse the current window).
welcome.content:
Expand the current server to browse its files and agent sessions.
[Add a remote server](command:agentWorkspace.addServer) to browse opencode / Codex / Claude Code sessions on other machines without switching windows.
config.sshTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout (seconds) for a single remote operation over SSH (scan, directory read, file preview).
config.logLevel.description: Log level for the "Agent Dock" output channel.
config.sshConnectionPersist.description: How long to keep idle SSH master connections alive for reuse (e.g. "10m", "8h", "yes" for indefinite, "0" to disable reuse).
config.remoteAutoRefresh.description: Automatically poll files/directories of other servers for changes (open editors and the tree update live).
config.remoteWatchIntervalSeconds.descri: How often (in seconds) remote files/directories of other servers are polled for changes.
config.sshTransport.description: Transport for operations on other servers: "persistent" keeps one SSH connection per server (SFTP for file ops, exec channels for scripts — low latency, no per-operation ssh process); "spawn" runs one ssh process per operation (legacy, no persistent connection).
config.sshHostKeyMode.description: Host key verification for persistent SSH connections: "yes" requires the host to be in ~/.ssh/known_hosts, "accept-new" automatically trusts and records unknown hosts, "no" skips verification (not recommended).
config.autoSave.description: Auto-save remote files of other servers (same policies as native `files.autoSave`, applied only to `agentdock-remote` files): `off` disables; `afterDelay` saves `agentDock.autoSaveDelay` ms after the last edit; `onFocusChange` saves when the editor loses focus (switch editor / focus terminal / window blur); `onWindowChange` saves when the window loses focus.
config.autoSaveDelay.description: Delay (ms) before auto-saving after the last edit when `agentDock.autoSave` is `afterDelay`.
